root_cause_verification.rationale: Static layout.headerMaxWidth (evaluated at module load) was replaced by useHeaderMaxWidth hook that re-evaluates on every render using useWindowDimensions, useRightSidebar, useIsTablet, useLocalSetting('sidebarCollapsed'). Hook is present in deployed bundle (3 refs). Consumer files Header.tsx and ChatHeaderView.tsx both apply the hook's output as inline style maxWidth override. The static import layout.headerMaxWidth is no longer referenced from the two consumer files.
